title: Jazzy American Salmon Casserole
description: A buttery salmon casserole with citrusy kiwifruit and creamy herb sauce, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Rinse quinoa and cook it in water according to package directions, then set it aside to cool slightly.
In a small bowl, whisk together almond milk, coconut cream, lemon zest, ground ginger, sea salt, and black pepper until smooth.
Rub salmon fillets with olive oil and place them skin side up in a greased 9x9 inch baking dish.
Pour the creamy sauce over the salmon fillets, making sure each piece is evenly coated.
Scatter the diced kiwis, chopped dill, and chopped parsley over the salmon and sauce.
Spoon the cooked quinoa over the top, covering the fish and fruit.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 20 minutes, then remove the foil and bake another 5 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Allow the casserole to rest for 5 minutes, then serve warm, garnishing with extra dill if desired.
